title: React Compiler schema exclusion
implementation: Migrated the donor babel.config.js react-compiler sources filter into the expo preset options: sources(filename) excludes normalized /packages/protocol/ paths (backslashes replaced before matching) while app.config.js keeps experiments.reactCompiler enabled. Only the compile configuration changed; no protocol source, runtime or type behavior touched. Added apps/mobile/babel.config.test.cjs (node --test) that runs the real babel-preset-expo + babel-plugin-react-compiler pipeline with the Metro caller contract (supportsReactCompiler) and asserts: an application component is still compiler-transformed (react/compiler-runtime memo cache), protocol sources are excluded on POSIX, Windows and mixed-separator paths, and lookalike paths outside packages/protocol stay compiled. Internal build filter only: no wire/SDK/UI interface change, no runtime behavior change, no downgrade concern; documented in apps/mobile/README.md and CHANGELOG.md. No new ADR (build configuration within existing client build ownership).
acceptance: Unix/Windows normalized protocol paths are excluded, application sources still compile, and schema runtime/typecheck behavior is preserved (no protocol files changed). Verified with the real Babel pipeline, not config-source copies or wiring assertions.

required: affected fmt/clippy/build/tests and runtime smoke for changed backend
affected SDK/UI/protocol checks and documented old-host/client downgrade
results: node --test apps/mobile/babel.config.test.cjs — 5 pass, 0 fail (real babel-preset-expo + babel-plugin-react-compiler, Metro caller supportsReactCompiler)
red proof: sources filter removed — 3 protocol-exclusion tests fail (hook-bearing fixture); filter restored — 5 pass
